reports.title: Vontier Reports Strong Third Quarter Results and Raises Full Year Adjusted EPS Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: •Initiates Q4 2026 guidance for adjusted diluted net EPS of $0.99 to $1.03
•Raises FY 2026 guidance for adjusted diluted net EPS of $3.60 to $3.64

RALEIGH, North Carolina, November 5, 2026 -- Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, today announced results for the third quarter ended October 2, 2026.

Reported sales in the third quarter decreased 2.1% year-over-year to $736.9 million, reflecting the impact from the divestiture of Teletrac Navman. Core sales increased 5.7% driven primarily by ongoing strength across our convenience retail facing businesses. Operating profit of $158.4 million increased 11.2% from the prior year, and operating profit margin increased approximately 260 basis points, to 21.5%. Adjusted operating profit of $179.3 million increased 12.1% from the prior year and adjusted operating profit margin increased 300 basis points to 24.3%. Net earnings were $99.0 million, and adjusted net earnings were $124.3 million, resulting in GAAP diluted net earnings per share of $0.73 and adjusted diluted net earnings per share of $0.92.

"Vontier delivered a strong third quarter, with results exceeding our guidance across sales, margin, and EPS. Increasing adoption of our innovative products and solutions is contributing to above-market growth. Our simplification and 80/20 initiatives are delivering more meaningful operating leverage, with savings now tracking ahead of our original commitment. These dynamics are strengthening our earnings profile and give us the confidence to raise our full-year outlook," said Mark Morelli, President and Chief Executive Officer.
